reviews.title: Effortless pickup
reviews.body: Picked up at 6am for an airport run and the car was already cooled and charged. Handover took four minutes.

reviews.title: Exactly as listed
reviews.body: Second time renting this one. Interior was spotless and the fuel policy was exactly as stated — no surprise charges.

reviews.title: Solid long-drive car
reviews.body: Great highway  stability on the Pune expressway. Only nitpick: the phone mount was missing.

reviews.title: Flexible and fair
reviews.body: Booking modification through the app was painless when our flight moved by a day.
